title: Does Reasoning Introduce Bias? A Study of Social Bias Evaluation and Mitigation in LLM Reasoning
reasoning: The paper includes 'Religion' as one of the primary social bias categories it benchmarks and evaluates. It uses the BBQ dataset to analyze model performance on religious categories, provides specific accuracy and bias metrics for religion in Table 1, and includes qualitative analysis and examples of religious stereotypes in Appendix A.6.
